typography.font_pairings_rationale: Azeret Mono brings a stark, technical, terminal-like feel necessary for a cybersecurity tool, while IBM Plex Sans remains legible and objective for dense dashboard data.

rules: No pure black or white. Use tinted darks.
Strict avoidance of matrix-green. Use desaturated teal/healthy green and electric blue instead.
Hover states must be explicitly styled with a lighter hue of the active state.

layout_spacing.general_strategy: Control Room Grid for the Dashboard (dense, clear hierarchy, 1px borders), and Swiss/Bento Grid for Marketing (asymmetry).
layout_spacing.container_padding: Generous padding on marketing (p-12 to p-24), tight functional padding on dashboard (p-4 to p-6).
layout_spacing.borders: Expose the skeleton. Use 1px border-border/40 for a 'Technical' look.

component_styling.shape: Sharp edges, 0px to 2px max border-radius. Avoid soft rounded shapes.
component_styling.cards: Flat background (#121212), 1px subtle border, no heavy drop shadows. Hover triggers a subtle -translate-y-1 and a glow or stronger border.
component_styling.buttons: Primary buttons: bg-[#4da3ff] text-[#0a0a0a] font-bold. Secondary/Outline: border-border text-white hover:bg-white/10.
component_styling.glassmorphism: Used only for floating sticky headers: backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#0a0a0a]/60 border-b border-white/10.
component_styling.tables: Dense rows, monospace font for IP/HWID data, distinct colored status dots.
component_styling.shadcn_overrides: Override Shadcn's default Vercel look (rounded-md, soft shadows). Make components sharp (rounded-none), use thin borders, remove excess padding in tables.

motion_interactions.hover: Transition transform 0.2s ease, opacity 0.2s ease. Explicit text color changes.
motion_interactions.entrance: Staggered fade-up for dashboard widgets and list items.
motion_interactions.loading: Use terminal-like ASCII loaders or simple monospace text 'Scanning...' rather than standard spinners.

media_and_icons.icon_library: @phosphor-icons/react (Duotone or regular weight for dense technical dashboards)

image_urls.description: Abstract dark nodes for the marketing hero section background. Darken with overlay.
Server rack illuminated with blue light. Use in feature cards or 'Downloads' section.
Metallic honeycomb grid. Use as subtle background texture with low opacity (10%) on the dashboard or admin panel.

media_and_icons.overlay_rule: Max bg-black/50 overlay on hero images to ensure readability without killing the visual.

instructions_to_main_agent: You are building a hybrid SaaS tool: Marketing page + Auth + User Dashboard + Admin Panel.
Use pure HTML + Tailwind for the marketing layout, avoiding rigid Shadcn cards there.
Use Shadcn UI for forms, dialogs, tables, dropdowns, and dashboard elements.

Crucial: Ensure every interactive element (buttons, links, inputs, tables, rows) has a `data-testid` attribute using kebab-case role-based naming (e.g., `data-testid="login-submit-button"`, `data-testid="download-windows-btn"`).
Never use purely transparent headers if content scrolls under them. Use the defined glassmorphism strategy.
Do not invent placeholder image URLs (no via.placeholder.com). Strictly use the images provided in `media_and_icons`.
